question: is there a minor in creative writing or is it just english
answer:
Yes—there is a Creative Writing Minor, not just English. The catalog lists it as a Minor in the School of Arts, Humanities, and Education. [15][1]

Requirements: LITR 280 INTRODUCTION TO CREATIVE WRITING; select 1 writing workshop from LITR 282 FICTION WRITING WORKSHOP, LITR 283 POETRY WRITING WORKSHOP, LITR 284 PERSONAL ESSAY: CREATIVE WRITING WORKSHOP, or LITR 291 CREATIVE WRITING TOPICS; select 1 poetry elective from LITR 201 READINGS IN POETRY, LITR 223 SURVEY OF AMERICAN POETRY, LITR 241 INTERNATIONAL POETRY, LITR 292 TOPICS IN AMERICAN POETRY, or LITR 314 TRANSATLANTIC 19TH CENTURY POETRY; select 1 prose elective from LITR 203 METHODS OF LITERARY STUDY, LITR 220 SURVEY OF AMERICAN LITERATURE: PRE-COLUMBIAN TO ROMANTIC, LITR 221 SURVEY OF AMERICAN LITERATURE: ROMANTIC TO CONTEMPORARY, LITR 226 AMERICAN SHORT STORY, LITR 234 CONTEMPORARY AMERICAN LITERATURE, LITR 273 MODERN NOVEL IN FRANCE, LITR 275 SURVEY OF LATIN AMERICAN LITERATURE, LITR 276 LITERATURE OF THE AMERICAS, or LITR 293 STUDIES IN AMERICAN FICTION; and LITR 381 CREATIVE WRITING CAPSTONE. [1]

The catalog also offers an English and Literary Studies BA. [1]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-MN-WRT) [15](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs)

question: what classes would i need to take for a business major, is it marketing or management or are those seperate
answer:
They’re separate Bachelor of Science majors in the Anisfield School of Business: Management BS and Marketing BS. The catalog lists no bachelor’s major called “business marketing management.” [1][2][17]

Both majors share these requirements: choose 1 of MATH 108, 110, 121; all ACCT 221, 222; BADM 223, 225, 495; ECON 101, 102; FINC 301; INFO 224; MGMT 302, 370; MKTG 290; 1 international course (ECON 323/325, HNRS 220, IBUS 321/322/326/305/335/336/340); 1 ethics course (BADM 301, HNRS 325, INFO 315); and PATH 001, 002, 003. [1][2]

Management additionally requires MGMT 340 and 410; 1 experiential course (MGMT 401, 466, 475); and 3 leadership/talent courses (INFO 333; MGMT 301, 303, 306, 315, 320, 321, 325, 330, 335, 343, 346, 373, 374, 390, 403, 420, 428, 466, 471, 472, 475, 490). [1]

Marketing additionally requires MKTG 310, 320, 330, 430, and 2 electives (MGMT 321; MKTG 350, 360, 370, 385, 390, 420, 440, 490). MKTG 430 is 4 credits; prerequisites: MKTG 320 and MKTG 330. [2][4]

Full catalog requirements: https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-BS-MNGM and https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SB-BS-MRKT. [1][2]

question: what are the gen ed requirements? how many credits of gen eds do i need total
answer:
For Ramapo students, the curriculum requires ten General Education courses: First Year Seminar, Social Science Inquiry, Critical Reading & Writing 102, Studies in the Arts & Humanities; one course each in Global Awareness, Historical Perspectives, Scientific Reasoning, and Quantitative Reasoning; and one course in two of Culture & Creativity, Systems, Sustainability, & Society, and Values & Ethics. Critical Reading & Writing 102 and Quantitative Reasoning must be taken within the first 64 credits. [2] At least one distribution course must be offered by a school other than the one housing your major. [2] Starting Fall 2026, the “out of school requirement” is no longer enforced in degree audit tools. [8]
The published policy says General Education “should not exceed 41 credits”; it does not state a required total number of credits. [3]
Transfer students with at least 48 credits, and returning students with at least 48 credits on their Ramapo transcript at re-enrollment, have specified waivers and remaining requirements; during academic advisement, they will be advised which courses remain. [4]
Approved General Education courses: https://catalog.ramapo.edu/college-wide-programs/gened#general-education-categories-and-courses [5]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/curriculum-and-assessment/) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#integrity-of-degree-programs1) [4](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#waiver-of-general-education-requirements1) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/curriculum-and-assessment/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/provost/home/comprehensive-academic-plan/resources/)

question: what is cmps 147 about and does it have prereqs
answer:
CMPS 147, COMPUTER SCIENCE I, is a 4-credit course. It introduces computer-based problem-solving and covers computer systems, ANSI C++, algorithm design, program development, debugging, testing, documentation, variables, data types, expressions, selection, repetition, functions and arrays. A course fee is required. It carries the Gen Ed 18-Quantitative Rsng (GEQR) attribute. [1]

Yes. question: can i double major in communication and something else or is that too many credits? also are there any certificates i could add
answer:
You may pursue a second major as an undergraduate. With two majors, no more than half the courses may count toward both, and you must complete all writing-intensive courses required for the second major. [3][4] The Communication Arts BA’s recommended 2026–2027 plan totals 128 credits and includes free electives for a minor, certificate, or second major; it does not say whether your individual plan would require too many credits. [1] For advice on your credit plan, contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising): success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441. [10]

The catalog lists these certificates: Applied Ethics Certificate; Business Essentials Certificate; Business Foundations-Graduate Certificate; Data Analyst-Graduate Certificate; Data Modeler-Graduate Certificate; Machine Learning Engineer-Graduate Certificate; Spanish for Health Care and Human Services Professionals Certificate. [2] Certificates are usually programs of study with credit-bearing courses, are not graduation requirements, and are removed from the degree audit. Graduate certificates require at least 9 credits beyond the Bachelor’s level. [8] The catalog does not specify which certificates you personally are eligible to add. [2]

To declare, complete the online major/minor declaration form: https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/declare-major-minor-certificate/; the Registrar’s Office updates your record in 5-7 days after submission. [10] To add fields for another major, minor, or certificate, select “Add Another Section.” [9]
